title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Courtesy Guidance with Worked Figures: Cure Speed Adjustment
content:
**Guidance.** On a courtesy credit for a late fee on a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, the cure adjustment is added to the courtesy share, the share of the late fee being reversed that the courtesy credit returns. The cure adjustment is measured on the calendar days from the missed due date to the credited date of the most recent payment: when those days are no more than 21, it is 0.01 multiplied by the difference between 21 and those days; when they are more than 45, it is minus 0.1; when they are more than 21 but no more than 45, there is no cure adjustment. The missed due date is the payment due date of the statement of the billing period that the most recent late fee on the account belongs to. The courtesy share is never below zero and never above 1.0.

## Worked figures

| Days from the missed due date to the most recent payment | Cure adjustment |
|---|---|
| 1 | 0.01 times 20: 0.20 |
| 6 | 0.01 times 15: 0.15 |
| 21 | 0.01 times 0: zero |
| 22 | zero |
| 45 | zero |
| 46 | minus 0.1 |
| 70 | minus 0.1 |

## Example (hypothetical dates)

Missed due date 28 April; most recent payment credited 4 May, 6 calendar days later: the adjustment is 0.15. Credited 20 June, 53 days later: minus 0.1.
